best_lineage.idea: Replace the O(n log n) merge sort with an LSD radix sort (4 passes of 8 bits) that computes all histograms in a single pass, skips constant bytes, and includes a fast early-exit check for already-sorted / reverse-sorted inputs. This should dramatically improve throughput across all distributions, especially sorted and reverse-sorted ones.
